answer: This is a Marketing Research Project Approval form dated April 27, 1981, for a project titled 'Side Stream Smoke Focus Groups' (Job #5546/1481) in the New Products category. The research will involve three focus groups (1 male, 2 female) of Reduced Tar smokers aged 18+ who smoke 10+ cigarettes daily, conducted in Ridgewood, N.J. on May 7th. The purpose is to determine if the NSS (No Side Stream) concept/product is viable based on smokers' reactions. The total cost estimate is $6,816, including a moderator fee of $4,500, facility cost of $1,500, and agency fee of $816. Ruth Manko Associates will conduct the research, using Suburban Associates as the facility, with D'Arcy/deGarmo as the agency. The topline oral presentation is scheduled for the week of May 18th, with the final written presentation due the week of May 25th.

All smokers will be 18 years and over and smoke 10+ cigarettes per day.
